original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州警方逮捕32岁连环手机盗窃嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州警方在阿瓦卡、伊苏阿尼奥查和姆格巴库等地多家酒店发生手机盗窃案后展开调查，逮捕了32岁嫌疑人伊费安伊·奥比。警方称，监控录像显示该嫌疑人涉案，其在审讯中据称已承认从酒店盗走五部安卓手机。目前该案为单一来源报道，相关指控尚未经法院审理确认。

location.raw_text: hotels in Awka, Isuaniocha and Mgbakwu communities, Anambra State

key_facts.fact: 阿南布拉州警方逮捕32岁涉嫌连环手机盗窃的嫌疑人伊费安伊·奥比

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: who allegedly stole Android phones from hotels in Awka

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a review of video surveillance footage allegedly linking the suspect to the incidents

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: during interrogation, the suspect reportedly confessed to stealing five Android phones from hotels in the affected communities

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人于2026年10月25日凌晨被阿马努凯警局警员逮捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The suspect was arrested in the early hours of October 25, 2026, by operatives attached to the Amanuke Police Division
